bubbles.speaker: guide
bubbles.text: Namaste. You have reached Pension Restart, an independent pension-guidance prototype. Please do not share an Aadhaar number, OTP, PIN or bank password. Which language would you prefer?

bubbles.speaker: guide
bubbles.text: Theek hai. Aap batayiye, pension ke saath kya dikkat aa rahi hai?

bubbles.speaker: caller
bubbles.text: December se meri pension nahi aayi. Bank mein poocha tha, par mujhe samajh nahi aaya ki kya karna hai.

bubbles.speaker: guide
bubbles.text: Kya November 2025 ke baad pension account mein koi pension credit hua?

bubbles.speaker: guide
bubbles.text: Kya aapne 2025 mein life certificate ya Jeevan Pramaan jama kiya tha?

bubbles.speaker: caller
bubbles.text: Mujhe yaad nahi. Shayad nahi kiya.

bubbles.speaker: guide
bubbles.text: Aapki baat se lagta hai ki life certificate miss hua ho sakta hai. Yeh final decision nahi hai. PPO ka pehla panna aur redacted pension statement madad kar sakte hain. Aadhaar ki photo upload mat kijiye.

bubbles.speaker: guide
bubbles.text: Call ke baad aapko ek written summary, document checklist aur suitable official routes milenge. Demo reference PR-2608-1042 taiyaar hai.
